children.name: action

Adds the documents to the index, replacing any that already exist under
the same ID.

children.name: $or
children.description: Filters of which at least one must match.

children.name: q
children.description:
The free-text query. Sits among the filters so a `query.graph` call converts
to `query.search` unchanged; the module lifts it out before compiling the
rest, so a provider never sees `q` as a field.
